summary: Play Lichess games, challenge players, solve puzzles, or play offline.
release_notes: Setup steps now name the Cobalt version this app needs. No change to play.

steps.text: Create a Lichess Personal Access Token granting only board:play.
Save the token in a private local file, then install it under the exact secret name lichess.

page_description: An unofficial Lichess client for Kobo. Play rated games at rapid and classical time controls, accept or send challenges, solve puzzles, or play the computer offline.
